Class Database

java.lang.Object
project.storage.Database
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Database extends Object implements Serializable
Singleton in-memory database for the KBTU university system. Persists all data to kbtu_database.dat via Java serialization. Always access through getInstance(); never construct directly.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static Database getInstance()
      Returns the single shared Database instance, loading it from disk on first call. Creates an empty database if no saved file exists.

    • saveToDisk

      public void saveToDisk()
      Serializes the current database state to kbtu_database.dat using an atomic write-to-temp-then-rename strategy to avoid corruption on crash.

    • resetInstance

      public static void resetInstance()
      Clears the in-memory singleton so the next getInstance() call reloads from disk. Useful in tests.

    • reloadFromDisk

      public void reloadFromDisk()
      Refreshes all collections from disk without replacing the singleton instance. Used by the interactive menu to pick up changes made by other processes.

      Inserts or updates a user entry (keyed by their ID).
